description: Generated judgment-answer schema — derived from schemas/discovery/lead.schema.json by schema's answer derivation; do not edit. Validates the schema-gated answer to a source adapter's survey operation: an object carrying `leads[]`, each item the canonical lead shape minus the envelope `source` key (the caller attributes every lead to the surveyed source).

leads.description: Every lead the survey surfaced, in source order.

items.description: Validates a single raw, unmerged `Lead` block under `## Lead inventory` in `discovery.md` per workflow §Discovery handshake. Each block is one lead as surfaced by one source: a `source` naming the binding that produced it, a kebab-case `lead` (unique only within that `source`), and a content-bearing per-source `synopsis`. Identity is the `(source, lead)` pair; the same `lead` MAY appear under different source keys, and cross-source unification is deferred to `/spec:plan`'s plan-time `propose` sub-step. `slices[].sources[].lead` resolves against the canonical `lead` id within the binding's `source`.

lead.description: Stable kebab-case lead identifier, unique only within its `source`. Re-survey of that source replaces the block by `(source, lead)`.

synopsis.description: Reconciliation-grade per-source headline of the lead as this source surfaced it. SHOULD name the operation/surface and its salient constraint distinctly enough that a same-slug lead from another source can be matched or distinguished on content, not just the slug. MAY span more than one line when one is too thin. Plan-time headline material only — never a back-door for slice-time `Evidence`, which remains the job of `extract`.

topics.description: Optional agent-authored per-lead topic slugs (kebab-case). Survey populates them as additional context; absent means unclassified. The CLI computes no grouping from `topics` — it is agent context plus the join key for the propose-time decision-contradiction warning. A missing `topics` never blocks reconciliation.
